host: Codex CLI exec, read-only sandbox, Python allowed, only the raw export in the folder

quick_question.prompt: There is a CSV file shipments_2025.csv in this folder: the export of our 2025 shipments. Which carrier is the most reliable? You may run Python with pandas to look at the file. Answer briefly.
quick_question.answer:
**Falke Transport leads overall:** 90.9% of shipments arrived on time, and 90.2% arrived on time and undamaged.

**Gams Cargo looks stronger on comparable destinations:** it beats Falke’s on-time rate in every country both serve. Falke’s overall lead reflects its destination mix, so there’s no universal winner.

Figures exclude 125 duplicate rows and unresolved in-transit shipments, combine carrier-name variants, and count lost shipments as failures.
